sources.title: National Infrastructure Planning Guidance Portal
sources.role: Current central index for National Infrastructure Planning Guidance
sources.facts: Updated 24 July 2026; lists the current guidance suite and transitional status after Planning and Infrastructure Act 2025 changes.
sources.guard: A portal entry identifies guidance status; it is not a project classification, accepted application or development consent.

sources.title: Planning Act 2008: Guidance on preparing an application: Part 1 - Pre-application steps
sources.role: Current government guidance on DCO pre-application preparation
sources.facts: Published 3 July 2026; describes statutory requirements, recommended preparation steps and the amended position on engagement and consultation.
sources.guard: Following pre-application guidance does not prove an application is ready, accepted, consented or environmentally acceptable.

sources.title: Planning Act 2008: Guidance on preparing an application: Part 2 - Application contents
sources.role: Current guidance on DCO application contents
sources.facts: Published 3 July 2026; explains statutory application content, plans, information and submission requirements.
sources.guard: A prescribed document list does not prove completeness, accuracy, acceptance or consent for a particular proposal.

sources.title: Planning Act 2008: Guidance on preparing an application: Part 3 - Contents of a draft Development Consent Order
sources.role: Current guidance on preparing a draft DCO
sources.facts: Published 3 July 2026; covers preparation and content of a draft Development Consent Order.
sources.guard: Drafting requirements do not prove that requested powers, requirements or compulsory acquisition provisions will be accepted.

sources.title: Planning Act 2008: Guidance on the acceptance stage of an application
sources.role: Current guidance on acceptance-stage tests and procedure
sources.facts: Published 3 July 2026; covers statutory requirements, the acceptance decision and steps after acceptance.
sources.guard: Acceptance for examination is not development consent and does not confirm the planning merits or deliverability of a project.

sources.title: Planning Act 2008: Guidance on the examination stage of an application
sources.role: Current guidance on examination of accepted DCO applications
sources.facts: Published July 2026; describes the inquisitorial examination process, evidence testing and the Examining Authority's role.
sources.guard: Participation in examination does not prove the recommendation, Secretary of State decision or discharge of requirements.

sources.title: Planning Act 2008: Guidance on the decision-making stage of an application
sources.role: Current guidance on Secretary of State DCO decision-making
sources.facts: Published 3 July 2026; explains grant/refusal, extensions, legal challenge and redetermination processes.
sources.guard: Decision-stage guidance is not a decision notice and cannot establish whether a named project has consent.

sources.title: Nationally Significant Infrastructure Projects: Pre-Application Advice on Environmental Impact Assessment
sources.role: Planning Inspectorate advice on EIA during NSIP pre-application
sources.facts: Published 27 July 2026; covers screening, scoping, consultation bodies, GIS shapefiles and the Rochdale Envelope.
sources.guard: Screening, scoping or mapped boundaries do not prove final impacts, mitigation adequacy, acceptance or consent.
